sketches.notes: Base plate footprint 50mm (X) x 30mm (Y) centered on the origin: X=-25..25, Y=-15..15. Symmetric about Y=0 (the XZ plane) as required. Extruded +Z 5mm -> Z=0..5.

Custom profile: vertical arm footprint - an axis-aligned rectangle 5mm (X) x 30mm (Y), X=-25..-20, Y=-15..15, no arcs. Outer face flush with the -X end of the base at X=-25; the 5mm thickness extends in the +X direction to X=-20. Full 30mm Y width keeps the part symmetric about Y=0. Extruded +Z 30mm -> Z=0..30, overlapping the base plate over the whole Z=0..5 band so the two bodies share real volume and fuse cleanly. Overall height is 30mm (arm shares the base thickness, NOT 30+5).

Custom profile: concave inside-corner fillet R=5mm, drawn in the XZ plane (sketch-local x = world X, sketch-local y = world Z). Closed boundary in order: (-22,4) -> (-15,4) -> (-15,5) -> quarter-circle arc of radius 5 centred at (-15,10) running from (-15,5) to (-20,10), concave toward the inside corner (-20,5) -> (-20,10) -> (-22,10) -> close back to (-22,4). The arc is tangent to the base top face Z=5 at (-15,5) and tangent to the arm inner face X=-20 at (-20,10), so it blends smoothly into both faces. The profile deliberately extends 1mm below the base top face (to Z=4) and 2mm into the arm (to X=-22) so the extruded solid overlaps both bodies and can be fused. Extruded 30mm along +Y from the plane at Y=-15 to span the entire 30mm width (Y=-15..15) as one continuous fillet. Fillet cross-section area = 25 - 25*pi/4 = 5.365 mm^2.

steps.label: Extrude base plate 50 x 30 x 5
steps.notes: Base plate from Z=0 to Z=5, spanning X=-25..25 and Y=-15..15.

steps.label: Extrude vertical arm 5 x 30 x 30 (Z=0..30)
steps.notes: Vertical arm from Z=0 to Z=30 at X=-25..-20, Y=-15..15. Extrusion starts at Z=0 (not Z=5) so it overlaps the base plate across the full 5mm base thickness - guarantees a volumetric fuse instead of a face-only contact, and keeps overall height at ARM_HEIGHT_Z = 30mm.

steps.label: Fuse arm plate to base plate
steps.notes: Produces the L-shaped body (one base plate + one vertical arm plate), overall 50 x 30 x 30, single solid.

steps.label: Extrude concave inside-corner fillet R=5 along full Y width
steps.notes: Additive quarter-round prism running the full 30mm Y width, filling the inside corner where the base top face Z=5 meets the arm inner face X=-20. The solid overlaps the base (1mm) and the arm (2mm) so the following union merges real volume. Modelling the fillet as this extruded quarter-round gives the exact geometry a 5mm concave fillet would produce (tangent to Z=5 at X=-15, tangent to X=-20 at Z=10) without relying on ambiguous whole-body edge selection.

steps.label: Fuse the inside fillet into the L-bracket
steps.notes: Final single water-tight solid. Expected volume = base 50*30*5 (7500) + arm 5*30*25 (3750) + fillet 30*(25 - 25*pi/4) (160.95) = 11410.95 mm^3, matching the brief target. No further edge blending is required or desired.

The profile deliberately extends 1mm below the base top face (to Z=4) and 2mm into the arm (to X=-22) so the extruded solid overlaps both bodies and can be fused. Extruded 30mm along +Y from the plane at Y=-15 to span the entire 30mm width (Y=-15..15) as one continuous fillet. Fillet cross-section area = 25 - 25*pi/4 = 5.365 mm^2.

steps.label: Fuse arm plate to base plate
